caption:
Designing a world-class mountain biking route in Costa Rica is about finding the quiet spaces between the maps. I spend hundreds of hours scouting these high-altitude ridges, looking for the transition where rugged gravel roads give way to forgotten singletrack. It is never just about the elevation; it is about the rhythm of the climb, the density of the cloud forest, and knowing exactly when to pause. This is how we build journeys that stay with you long after the descent.
